visualCharacteristics: Grid of dark full-bleed feature cards (1 column mobile, 2 at 600px, 3 at 900px). Each card is a background image with a brand title, supporting text, and an optional CTA overlaid over the bottom.
contentPattern: Repeating rows; each row = image cell (used as full-bleed background) + body cell with title, supporting text, and optional CTA link.
usage: Cruise-line brand feature rows and other image-forward promotional cards distinct from the deal cards.
